notes: Read the source file line by line before editing. The default-exported ChargingCurvePage, every state name (selectedSessionId, activeVehicleId, start/end), the useMemo names (stats/selectedSession/curveData/sessionOptions), the API path (GET /charging via useChargingSessionsPaginated with limit 200 + start/end), SI handling (peak_power_w/avg_power_w watts → /1000 kW, total_energy_added_wh Wh → /1000 kWh), and all i18n keys are preserved verbatim.

L1 import {useMemo, useState, type ChangeEvent} -> useMemo/useState preserved; useCallback/useEffect added for the inlined hooks; ChangeEvent (a DOM type) is dropped — handleSessionChange takes the native Select's string value directly, mirroring web e.target.value.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined native useTranslation(): t(key, fallback?, vars?) returns the English fallback (or key) and applies {{var}} interpolation so charging.curve.sessionId 'Session #{{id}}' still substitutes; no i18n runtime in the parity bundle.

L3 useChargingSessionsPaginated from @/api/hooks/useCharging -> the already-ported native ../../../api/hooks/useCharging (same vehicleId + {limit,start,end} signature, same /charging query key); its row type ApiChargingSession is imported as a type (id is a number — matching the web ChargingSession — and it already carries avg_power_w/start_place/start_odometer_m/end_odometer_m).

L4 useSelectedVehicle from @/hooks/useSelectedVehicle -> inlined native useSelectedVehicle over the ported useVehicles(): keeps the web hook's final 'first vehicle is the default' precedence in local state (RN has no router/query precedence or persisted store).

L5 useSettings from @/hooks/useSettings (side-effect theme load) -> the ported native ../../../api/hooks/useSettings; the bare useSettings() call at L30 is preserved to warm the same /settings cache, and the inlined useFormatting/useChartPalette read it for currency/locale/palette.
L6 usePageTitle from @/hooks/usePageTitle -> inlined native no-op hook (RN has no document.title); the call site + translated title key are preserved.

L7 useRangeState from @/hooks/useRangeState -> inlined in-memory native useRangeState (RN has no URL/localStorage): defaultPresetId 'all' seeds start='2015-01-01'..end=today and setRange replaces the window driving the query; the {start,end,setRange} surface the page uses is preserved (persistKey accepted, no native target).

L8 PageContainer from @/components/layout -> inlined: the header (title/subtitle + actions row) collapses directly into the page ScrollView (the loading/empty branches need their own headers, so a separate PageContainer component was not extracted).

L9 GlassPanel, Select from @/components/ui -> GlassPanel is the ported native ../../../../components/ui/GlassPanel; Select is inlined as a pressable option-chip row whose onChange yields the chosen value mirroring web e.target.value, with the placeholder surfaced as a caption when nothing is selected.
L10 TimeStamp from @/components/data-display -> inlined native TimeStamp rendering the absolute formatted datetime (the web 'auto' time_format runtime is unavailable in the parity bundle).
L11 FadeIn from @/components/motion -> the ported native ../../../components/motion/FadeIn (delay in seconds supported) wrapping the same sections/delays (0.05/0.07/0.1/0.15/0.2/0.25).

L12 RangePicker, VehicleSelect from @/components/forms -> RangePicker is the ported native ../../../components/forms/RangePicker (value {start,end}, onChange(value), align 'end', triggerTestId 'charging-curve-range'); VehicleSelect is inlined and prop-wired (vehicleId/vehicles/onChange) because RN can't share the web hook's prop-less selection store across instances.

L13-22 the 8 ../components/charging-curve sub-components -> SessionCurveChart is the already-ported native ../components/charging-curve/SessionCurveChart (imported + reused as <SessionCurveChart curveData={curveData} />); SummaryStatsGrid/SessionDetailPanel/SessionComparisonChart/ChargerTypeChart/SpeedTrendChart/TimeToChargeSection (and its YearlyTrendChart)/LoadingSkeleton are inlined native equivalents in this file (their sibling modules are not yet ported).

L13-22 chart substitution: every Recharts AreaChart/LineChart/ComposedChart stack (CartesianGrid/XAxis/YAxis/Tooltip/Bar/Line/Cell + chartGrid/axisTickSm/AREA_DEFAULTS/ChartTooltip/ResponsiveContainer) collapses onto the already-ported native <AreaChartWrapper> series model (grid/axes + an always-visible latest-value summary; per-cell CHARGER_COLORS fills collapse to the series-level CHART_COLORS fallback), all wrapped by the ported native <ChartContainer> keeping each title/subtitle/ariaLabel/exportable/exportFilename + the exportable data table.
